districts.label: Northgate / North Market Industrial
districts.oneLineDistinction: Multi-tenant office/warehouse and lighter service formats
districts.shortDescription: Northgate / North Market provides Sacramento’s clearest reviewed setting for lighter Flex, multi-tenant office/warehouse, service-industrial and contractor uses. Its bounded identity centers on Northgate and North Market Boulevard rather than broad Natomas. Businesses should use the district to understand a northern, lighter operating context while confirming office ratio, unit configuration and use permissions at the property level.
worthKnowing: Exact office ratio, loading, parking and permitted use remain property-specific.

districts.label: Power Inn Industrial
districts.oneLineDistinction: Industrial-led Flex for production and service operations
districts.shortDescription: Power Inn supports Flex when the requirement remains operational: office/warehouse, contractor/service, light production and industrial-led mixed use. It is the heavier, broader operating setting in Sacramento’s reviewed Flex universe, not a generic office-first Flex district. The area’s range is useful for comparison, but no district-level statement establishes the configuration or capability of a particular building.
worthKnowing: Confirm exact unit layout, building systems, loading and permitted use for each property.

districts.label: River District / Richards Boulevard
districts.oneLineDistinction: Adaptive reuse and mixed employment on transitional industrial blocks
districts.shortDescription: The River District’s mix of legacy warehouses, government offices and redevelopment creates a contextual Flex story rather than a deep, standardized Flex market. Some buildings may support office/operational combinations or adaptive reuse, but the district is changing and formats are inconsistent. It is useful for businesses exploring close-in mixed employment settings, while Power Inn and Northgate remain the clearer reviewed operating districts.
worthKnowing: Flex identity is contextual; verify building format, current use and redevelopment constraints.
